# 2 Clement — Chapter 13 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 13
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Brothers, it is past time to repent. We need to clear our heads and turn toward what is good, because we are saturated with foolishness and wickedness. Let us wash away our past sins and repent with our whole being — and be saved.
2. Let us stop trying to please people and stop living just to please ourselves. Let us also live righteously enough that those outside the community will see it — so that God's Name will not be dragged through the mud because of us.
3. The Lord says: "My name is being blasphemed constantly among all the nations." And again: "A curse on the person because of whom my name is blasphemed." How is it blasphemed? "Because you do not do what I want."
4. Here is what happens: when unbelievers hear from us the words of God, they are struck by how beautiful and elevated they are. But then they see that the way we live does not match what we say — and admiration curdles into mockery. They say it is all a fairy tale, a fraud.
5. When they hear us say that God teaches: "There is no credit in loving those who love you — the real achievement is loving your enemies and those who hate you" — that kind of teaching astonishes them. But then they see that we cannot even love those who hate us, only those who already love us. And they laugh at us, and the Name is brought into contempt.
